a question about tickets for the health center：此項把「an invitation to the Sunday school show at」改成「a question about tickets for」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center」。
an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center」。

an invitation to a show at the health center on next Tuesday：此項把「the Sunday school show at the health center」改成「a show at the health center on next Tuesday」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Sunday school show at the health center」。
